units.title: Furniture Layout (residential unit)
topics: 1.1. Interior layout and design of furniture of a residential unit as per given requirements
1.2. Elevations and sections with respect to furniture layout and interior as per materials and finishes
uos: 1.a. Apply the principles of space planning related to interior design
1.b. Appreciate the applications of various materials and finishes used in interior design

units.title: False ceiling & lighting
topics: 2.2. Construction details of all ceiling materials
2.4. Types of lighting fixtures in the ceiling
uos: 2.a. Design of a false ceiling for a given residential unit with respect to furniture layout
2.b. Understand the importance of lighting and electrification with respect to furniture & false ceiling layouts

units.title: Flooring detail
topics: 3.1. Types of interior flooring materials with respect to their use in interior space and their properties
3.3. Types of finishing e.g. polishing for stone, etc.
uos: 3.a. Apply the principles of designing a flooring pattern for a given residential unit
3.b. Put into practice the latest materials and finishes available in the market

units.title: Furniture & Kitchen detailing
topics: 4.1. Kitchen drawings with section (platform, supports, fascia, below & above platform storage, dado, etc)

4.2. Detailed drawings for any one e.g. Sofa set, Double or Single Bed, Wardrobe, etc. Interior Design and Detailing Course Code: 3345002 ________________________________________________________________________________________________ GTU/NITTTR, Bhopal/13-14 Gujarat State
uos: 4.a. Use design parameters for preparing a kitchen layout and its details
4.b. Apply the design parameters for preparing detailed drawings for any given piece of furniture
